title: Jed Runewatcher
wikitext: {{npcbox |name=Jed Runewatcher |level=59 |type=Rare Elite |image=Jed Runewatcher.jpg |title = Blackhand Legion |sex = Male |location=[[Upper Blackrock Spire]] |instance=Upper Blackrock Spire |race=Orc |creature=Humanoid |faction=Combat |health=8,800 |status=Killable }} '''Jed Runewatcher''' is a rare spawn [[orc]] in [[Upper Blackrock Spire]]. He may wander in the room of [[Goraluk Anvilcrack]] or in the Furnace (near [[The Beast]]). It is possible to use the /target command from the entrance of [[Blackrock Spire]] to check whether he is spawned [[Goraluk Anvilcrack]]'s room, but you must be past Blackrock Stadium (where you fight [[Rend Blackhand]] before /target will work if he is spawned in the Furnace.
